description: Want to be a part of a company that’s making a difference? We’re a growing global tech company, with huge potential for curious and caring minds, committed to each other, to deliver solutions that protect people and the planet for future generations. Our team of experts are focused on creating meaningful impact and making a real difference for our customers. 🌍 Impact: A strong connection to our mission through product, customer and impact is essential. We protect people and the planet by helping businesses mitigate risks and create safer, healthier workplaces. 💡 Innovation: Trusted by over 11,000 customers, you’ll have the chance to work with industry experts and thought leaders, dedicated to driving positive change. We believe in fostering a trusting environment that empowers our team to grow, innovate, and succeed. 📈 Growth: Connect commercial growth to personal growth opportunities. Benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities for ambitious professionals seeking development in a rapidly expanding sector. We're on a mission to protect people and the planet by building and deploying transformative software. We need everyone's energy and commitment, regardless of region or rank, to make that mission a reality for millions more customers. Our culture code, a set of principles that underpins our values, is our commitment to each other and working better together. Join EcoOnline and be part of a mission dedicated to driving positive change. Read on to learn more about the opportunity and how you can have a positive impact! About The Role As our Product Owner you will play a key role in delivering safety-critical software used by emergency services, government agencies, corporate resilience and business continuity teams when it matters most. Sitting within our Product Operations team, you will own day-to-day product delivery for D4H, translating approved roadmap initiatives into high-quality, measurable and supportable software deliverables. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, QA and operational stakeholders to ensure teams have the clarity, direction and product decisions needed to deliver effectively. This is an opportunity to help evolve a trusted, proven platform as it scales into new markets and connects into EcoOnline’s broader EcoOne platform, including identity, data and analytics, and dedicated AI platform services. You will play a key role in helping EcoOnline move customers from compliance to visibility to prediction, with AI becoming a first-class capability that supports crisis readiness, incident response and operational resilience. Key Responsibilities Translate roadmap initiatives into deliverable product solutions, increments, epics, features and user stories. Own backlog quality and prioritisation, ensuring engineering teams have clear, actionable and well-defined requirements. Use AI day-to-day to accelerate specification writing, backlog grooming, data analysis and QA acceptance. Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to shape solutions that balance customer needs, technical constraints and delivery timelines. Manage delivery scope while protecting agreed objectives, escalating significant changes where strategic decisions are required. Provide timely product direction throughout delivery, resolving day-to-day questions around execution, operations and implementation. Coordinate release readiness, including documentation, release notes, operational preparation and successful deployment. Define clear acceptance criteria, support testing and quality assurance, and ensure delivered capabilities can be measured after release. Use customer feedback and product data to support continuous improvement and maintain high product quality. Factor AI governance, data-handling considerations and model limitations into product design, acceptance criteria and delivery decisions. What We're Looking For 2+ years’ experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager delivering software products. Fluent, practical and daily use of AI tools to write specs, groom backlogs, analyse information and move faster. Demonstrated technical fluency, with the ability to work confidently with Engineering and Architecture teams. Experience influencing without authority and driving decisions across multiple R&D teams or stakeholder groups. Experience shipping AI-built or AI-designed product features, with an understanding of what makes an AI capability production-ready, trustworthy and usable in high-stakes environments. Strong backlog and delivery management skills across epics, stories, acceptance criteria and the software development lifecycle. Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, data models and system architecture. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities across internal teams. Working knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, such as prompting, RAG, model limitations and evaluation. Awareness of AI governance, data sensitivity and compliance considerations in regulated, multi-region product environments. Ideally, experience in public safety, emergency management, crisis or business continuity, or other safety-critical or mission-critical software environments. Curiosity, pace and commercial awareness, with the ability to understand the “why” behind product decisions and keep delivery moving. Our Benefits We offer a variety of global benefits which are listed below! Please note a country-specific breakdown will be provided during your interview process. 🌴 Generous Paid Time Off 🍼 Extended Parental Leave ❤️‍🩹 Robust Health Coverage 💡 Accelerated Learning Paths 🧘‍♂️Team Wellness Initiatives 📆 Company-wide Events 🌎 Employee Resource Groups ⭐️ Recognition awards EcoOnline is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels safe and empowered to be themselves. Our Talent Acquisition team reviews all applications and believes in the potential of individuals who may not meet all the specific requirements but demonstrate the attitude, alignment with our values and drive to succeed. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need any assistance due to a disability, please speak to your talent acquisition partner. While EcoOnline may occasionally partner with professional recruitment agencies, we will never ask or require candidates to pay for CV writing, career coaching, recruitment services or any part of our hiring process . If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent EcoOnline and are unsure whether the opportunity is legitimate, please exercise caution and verify the communication through our official careers page or by contacting us directly. At EcoOnline, we may use AI-assisted note-taking technology during interviews to help capture key discussion points accurately and allow interviewers to focus on the conversation. AI is used only as an administrative support tool. All candidate assessments and hiring decisions are made by trained recruiters and hiring managers. We are committed to handling personal information responsibly and in line with applicable privacy regulations. / At EcoOnline, we believe in the power of technology to reshape how organisations protect their people and the planet, paving the way for a safer, more sustainable future. As a global SaaS leader, we’re at the forefront of innovation in workplace health, safety, and sustainability. Our team is passionate about creating meaningful impact and making a real difference. Trusted by over 11,000 customers, we’re recognised as pioneers in our field, delivering expertise and guidance to empower our customers at every stage of their safety and sustainability journey.
title: Product Owner

description: Job: Business Analyst – Data Governance Location: Dublin, hybrid — 2-3 days/week in office (North Dublin) Type: Contract Duration: 12 months Salary / Rate: 350-375 per day We are a looking for a talented Business Analyst with experience supporting enterprise Data Governance initiatives. In the job, you will be defining requirements, improving data quality/governance processes, and acting as the bridge between business stakeholders (Data & Analytics, Technology, Customer, Commercial, Finance, Operations) and technical teams. You would report to the Data Governance Lead. The role will split is roughly 70% Business Analysis/Stakeholder Management, 30% Data Governance/technical understanding — this is not a Data Engineer or Data Architect role. We are looking for people with the below experience: Proven Business Analyst experience in data, analytics, governance, or technology environments Hands-on experience with Data Governance and Data Quality programmes — mandatory Experience gathering/documenting business and functional requirements Experience facilitating workshops and stakeholder sessions Knowledge of data catalogue/metadata management platforms (Atlan, Collibra, Purview) Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills Experience working in Agile delivery environments Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements Ideally some experience with Data Access Management processes Some exposure to Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, or Databricks Some experience using Jira and Confluence Ideally a background in enterprise-scale, customer, finance, or operational organisations Consulting experience in Data Governance or Data Transformation Please note, that this role is not really suited to people with the below, if it mixes with the above, we would be keen to speak with you. No hands-on exposure to Data Governance, Data Quality, or Data Management initiatives (this is why the previous candidate didn't work out — governance experience is now non-negotiable) Heavily technical profile lacking real Business Analysis experience Pure reporting/BI Analyst background with limited stakeholder engagement Limited experience gathering requirements or facilitating workshops Experience limited to project administration rather than true BA responsibilities Cannot realistically commit to regular Dublin office attendance

description: ABOUT BRUNEL Founded in 1975, Brunel has developed into an international group with 12,000 employees and a turnover of €1.4 billion. We deliver Project and Consulting Solutions, Workforce Solutions and Global Mobility Solutions that transform global projects in Renewables, Conventional Energy, Mining, Life Sciences, Future Mobility, Industrials & Technology and many other sectors. Brunel is listed on Euronext Amsterdam NV and is included in the Amsterdam Small Cap Index (AScX). The organisation has grown into a renowned global brand with more than 120+ offices in over 40 countries on 6 continents. The head office of Brunel International is located in Amsterdam. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Business Analyst within the Global IT Team (GIT), you will belong to a team of ~ 10 business analysts that are focused across various projects, systems and applications. This will provide the opportunity to collaborate and learn with colleagues with a similar skillset coming from diverse backgrounds. Your stakeholders will be your colleagues within the IT team that have a technical focus on our IT applications and processes, as well as managers from the business (internal clients) based both in our Amsterdam HQ and possibly across other global regions too. ABOUT THE TEAM The Global IT Team (GIT) is responsible for all of Brunel's business-critical applications worldwide. This team consists of four agile teams that, based on Devops, design and develop the right functionality and applications for our international regions and manage them together with our partners. Within these teams we work together with modern technology and IT partners, and we continue to innovate to provide our business with the best IT systems. WHAT YOU'LL DO Developing a deep understanding of our business and users’ needs, specifying requirements and translating into user stories; Drawing up additional functional specifications that fit within the set of architectural frameworks; Assessing functional and technical designs; Making impact analysis of changes to business processes, related information systems and advising on this; Being the first point of contact for the Agile development teams Working together with the Product Owner having an opinion about the business value of changes. Working closely with our partners to get the best from their products WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Bachelor's or master's degree in business administration, IT or similar Excellent Dutch and/or English communication and writing skills Demonstrable work experience in an agile/scrum, SAFe environment; experience in working with Azure DevOps Demonstrable experience with process, business, information and/or system analysis Ability to retrieve and describe requirements and translate them into user stories/use cases Knowledge and experience with modelling and techniques such as UML and BPMN Training/certifications in the field of business/information analysis and architecture (eg IREB, BABOK, UML, BPMN, TOGAF) are a plus. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, resistance to stress and confidence Ability to deal with a wide scope of tasks, monitor overview and set priorities and explain complex matters in a simple way Previous experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Microsoft Power Platform Previous experience in a recruitment, staffing or a similar industry INTERVIEW PROCESS Two interviews and an online assessment WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Competitive base salary. Hybrid & flexible working – 3 days in the office. Coaching and mentoring through weekly check-ins. Friendly, collaborative & supportive team environment. Laptop and smart phone with Microsoft powered IT tools. Benefits; including pension scheme, group health insurance, 26 paid vacation days with the option to buy upto 40 vacation days per year, travel allowance scheme, bicycle lease plan, gym discount. Through the Brunel Academy - Brunel's learning & development programme - you have every opportunity to continue to develop yourself, both professionally and personally.

description: Ben jij een Business Analyst die energie krijgt van het verbeteren van processen, het verbinden van business en IT en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën? Wil je een zichtbare bijdrage leveren aan de digitale transformatie van een internationale organisatie? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou. Als Business Analyst Digital & AI Transformation speel je een belangrijke rol bij het identificeren, analyseren en realiseren van verbeterinitiatieven binnen CED. Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, processen en technologie en helpt de organisatie om kansen op het gebied van digitalisering, automatisering en AI om te zetten in concrete oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met managers, key users, ontwikkelteams en andere stakeholders om behoeften vanuit de business op te halen en deze te vertalen naar duidelijke requirements, functionele specificaties en user stories. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat teams beschikken over de juiste informatie om oplossingen te ontwikkelen die daadwerkelijk aansluiten op de behoefte van de gebruikers. Daarnaast vertaal je complexe businessvraagstukken naar concrete AI-use cases en automatiseringsmogelijkheden. Je identificeert kansen voor digitalisering, AI en procesautomatisering binnen verschillende businessdomeinen en onderzoekt hoe deze kunnen bijdragen aan meer efficiëntie, kwaliteit en klantwaarde. Binnen de rol ben je betrokken bij uiteenlopende initiatieven binnen verschillende businessdomeinen, zoals Property, Mobility, Forensic, EMN en T&I. Je werkt aan projecten op het gebied van procesverbetering, digitalisering, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI-toepassingen en Power Platform-oplossingen. Hierbij maak je gebruik van data-analyses en dashboards om verbeterkansen inzichtelijk te maken en besluitvorming te ondersteunen. Je combineert een sterke analytische basis met een pragmatische aanpak om kansen om te zetten in concrete resultaten. Je bent betrokken vanaf het eerste idee tot aan de validatie van een oplossing. Je faciliteert gesprekken met stakeholders, werkt requirements uit, begeleidt de vertaalslag naar IT, test opgeleverde functionaliteiten en ondersteunt gebruikers tijdens implementaties. Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw rol is het valideren van oplossingen en het delen van kennis, zodat teams de juiste keuzes kunnen maken en de kwaliteit van de opgeleverde oplossingen wordt geborgd. Een gemiddelde werkweek bestaat uit een combinatie van stakeholderoverleggen, requirementssessies, het uitwerken van user stories, het testen van opgeleverde functionaliteiten, het documenteren van oplossingen en het onderzoeken van nieuwe mogelijkheden voor de business. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je hebt veel ruimte om eigen initiatieven op te pakken wanneer je kansen ziet die voldoende businesswaarde opleveren. Hier kom je te werken CED is dé specialist op het gebied van schadeprocesmanagement. Daarbij hebben we een heldere visie: we beschermen en behouden wat voor mensen van waarde is. Binnen de domeinen Mobility, Property en Vitality maken ruim 1.500 collega's in 14 Europese landen deze belofte iedere dag waar. We werken voor organisaties zoals verzekeraars, vastgoedbedrijven, woningcorporaties, leasemaatschappijen, zorgverleners, grote corporates en overheden. De kracht van CED ligt in ons geïntegreerde aanbod. Van preventie en risicobeheersing tot schadeafhandeling en herstel bieden wij een volledig dienstenpakket. Hierdoor zijn wij niet alleen een full-service dienstverlener, maar vooral een organisatie die waarde creëert en behoudt voor klanten en eindgebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt 4 tot 7 jaar ervaring als Business Analyst, Information Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een digitale, data- of IT-omgeving. Daarnaast beschik je over: Aantoonbare ervaring met het faciliteren van requirements workshops en het documenteren van bedrijfsprocessen met behulp van methodieken zoals BPMN, UML en andere business analysis technieken. Ervaring met het analyseren van businessbehoeften en het vertalen hiervan naar functionele specificaties, user stories en AI-use cases. Ervaring met het ondersteunen van business transformatie-, standaardisatie- en continuous improvement-initiatieven. Ervaring met data-analyse, dashboardontwikkeling en datagedreven besluitvorming. Ervaring met User Acceptance Testing (UAT), feedbackmanagement en adoptie van nieuwe oplossingen. Ervaring met verandermanagement, stakeholdermanagement, training en gebruikersadoptie binnen complexe organisaties. Kennis van en ervaring met het identificeren van kansen op het gebied van AI, automatisering en procesoptimalisatie. Ervaring met samenwerking tussen business, architectuur- en IT-teams om digitale oplossingen te ontwerpen en te implementeren. Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Agents, Prompt Engineering en Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate en Power BI). Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Een proactieve, pragmatische en resultaatgerichte houding met een aantoonbaar trackrecord in het realiseren van businesswaarde. Ervaring binnen de verzekeringsbranche (Insurance) is een harde vereiste. Pré / aanvullende voorkeur Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je bij voorkeur ervaring binnen één of meer van de volgende domeinen: Mobility Insurance Claims & Claims Management Schadenbehandeling Property Insurance Insurance Operations Wat heeft CED jou te bieden? Bij CED krijg je de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de digitale toekomst van de organisatie. Je werkt aan uitdagende businessvraagstukken, krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en kunt actief meebouwen aan innovatieve oplossingen die het verschil maken voor collega's en klanten. Wij bieden jou: Een rol met echte verantwoordelijkheid en zichtbare impact. Veel ruimte om zelf kansen te signaleren en verbeteringen door te voeren. De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere digitale, data- en AI-transformatie van CED. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4522 en €5919 op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring. Vakantiegeld, een 13e maand en bovenwettelijke vrije dagen via het Individueel Keuzebudget. De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Een telefoonvergoeding. Een thuiswerkbeleid dat bijdraagt aan een gezonde werk-privébalans. Wil jij de verbindende schakel zijn tussen business en technologie en bijdragen aan innovatieve oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde creëren? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

description: About Atos Group Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 67,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €10 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris. The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space. Are you passionate about bridging the gap between business needs and technology? We are seeking a skilled B usiness Analyst to join our Netherlands-based team. In this role, you’ll leverage the latest technology trends to drive business growth and optimize operations. You’ll analyze requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver impactful solutions, all while collaborating with diverse stakeholders in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. Responsibilities Evaluate business systems and user needs in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. Document requirements, define project scope, and design solutions that align with business goals. Translate customer requirements into user stories and high-quality software designs. Provide insights on process improvements and automation strategies. Create workflow diagrams and analyze system capabilities, delivering actionable specifications. Manage and prioritize requirements backlogs, collaborating with stakeholders to refine and clarify needs. Propose system modifications based on analysis of current practices. Support team efforts, fostering collaboration to achieve organizational objectives. Requirements Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in fields like Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Management. Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in business analysis or a similar role. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills. Ability to engage with and challenge business process owners constructively. Proven experience in managing stakeholder expectations and facilitating cross-functional collaboration. Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps. Certifications such as IREB, BCS, BABOK, BISL, or ISQI. Familiarity with BPM, UML, Workflow Diagrams, and TOGAF frameworks. Knowledge of APIs, integration tools, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus. Language Proficiency Fluency in both Dutch and English, with excellent written and spoken communication skills. Experience across industries such as Public, Financial Services, or Manufacturing is an advantage. What We Offer A market-conform salary Great secondary benefits such as; Mobility budget or lease car 29 vacation days Health insurance & Pension scheme End-of-year bonus Performance bonus arrangement Holiday pay Laptop and phone provided by the company Hybrid Model (2-3 times per week in the office, or on location at the client) Challenging career opportunities at both national and international levels A personal development plan that you set up together with your manager Including internal and external (technology) courses and certifications Working with established clients and on impactful projects Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all. Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment. Choose your future. Choose Atos.

description: We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products. We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that! As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options. We’re a world-class, well-funded, diverse team from over 20 different countries that believes in the product we’re building and the service we’re providing for our members. We’ve grown significantly in the last 18 months and are evolving our Marketing structure to reflect that. About The Role You’re the Product team’s first analyst, though not the company’s first. The Data & Analytics team already own the pipelines, tables, and models beneath the product. Your job is to turn what’s in that data into decisions PMs can act on. Right now, nobody does that. You report to the CPO, who sets the strategic direction and clears the way with other teams. We’re hiring at the Senior level because the work needs it. Nobody has scoped this role before, which means you will. You’re the subject matter expert on product analytics here: you decide what questions matter, what data actually answers them, and what a healthy reporting rhythm looks like for this company. Your manager sets strategic direction and clears organisational blockers that need executive weight. Everything else (the analysis, the frameworks, the judgment calls) is yours. Responsibilities Be the Product team’s eyes: Dig into user behavioural data and find out why, not just what happened. We have dashboards for everything, but they don’t always explain what’s behind the numbers. That’s your job. You’ll decide which questions are worth answering. Connect Product and Data Engineering: Data Engineering owns the pipelines, tables, and models. You’ll turn a PM’s question into a scoped, technical ask they can build against and make the case for why it matters when priorities compete. This relationship is yours to build and run. Support the CPO directly: Handle recurring insight and reporting requests, packaging insights for senior leaders clearly and using your own judgment. Set the standard for how we measure success: Decide how we track KPIs and maintain clean, reliable data. This won’t just be your own practice; it will become the standard that PMs, and eventually other analysts, are expected to follow. Own where Product Analytics goes next: This function doesn’t exist yet — you’re building it. Decide what to track next, what to retire, and what we should be measuring in six months that we aren’t today. Own how we track product launches, before and after: Be involved before a feature ships so the right tracking is in place from day one, rather than something that needs to be patched afterwards. Once it’s live, continue monitoring performance and build the habits and infrastructure needed to make this standard practice. Reconcile data across platforms: When Mixpanel, our product data, and our marketing data disagree, investigate and reconcile the differences. Flag issues when the solution requires more than Analytics can address alone. Introduce better tooling: Identify and implement better tools, including AI-assisted analysis and workflows, wherever they can make us more efficient. You’ll have a Claude Enterprise licence from day one. What you'll need to succeed 3–5 years’ experience in product or customer analytics, ideally working alongside Product or Data Engineering teams. Strong SQL and/or Python skills (or equivalent), with confidence working with large, complex, and messy production datasets. Experience with product or customer analytics tools, such as Mixpanel, Google Analytics (GA), Power BI, AB Tasty, or similar platforms. Comfortable working with ambiguity: Able to scope problems, make informed judgment calls, and course-correct independently without waiting for someone else to provide the answer. Good judgment around escalation: Know when a blocker requires executive support and are confident raising it when necessary, while remaining comfortable operating autonomously day to day. Able to influence without authority: Build strong relationships across departments, understand what teams genuinely need, and communicate your recommendations in terms that resonate with different stakeholders. Self-starting and proactive: Comfortable taking ownership and acting without waiting for permission or detailed direction. End-to-end analytics experience: Ideally, you’ve built or maintained dashboards and analyses from start to finish, even if you haven’t previously built an entire analytics function. Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate, automate, and improve your analytical workflows. Bonus: Previous experience within fintech, lending, financial services, or another regulated industry. Don’t meet all the listed requirements? Research shows that women and people of underrepresented groups often don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% qualified. As an equal opportunities employer, we know that diversity is a key part of our teams' successes - so if your experience doesn’t fit perfectly but this role excites you, we’d love for you to apply. We’re committed to Creditspring being an inclusive environment where employees feel welcomed, valued and listened to; we want you to thrive as your true self. Please note that the People Team is contactable only via people@creditspring.co. Unsolicited emails to other team members will not be actioned.

description: ANWB Energie bevindt zich in een cruciale groeifase: van een succesvolle startup naar een volwassen, professioneel energiebedrijf. We groeien hard naar een toekomst waarin we ~500.000 klanten bedienen met een omzet van ~500 miljoen euro. Binnen deze dynamische context bouwen we aan een schaalbare, robuuste organisatie die klaar is voor duurzame groei. We maken de transitie van een functiegerichte structuur naar een productgestuurde, agile organisatie. De kern daarvan is het werken in multidisciplinaire delivery teams, gegroepeerd rondom klantproposities zoals Energie Leveren en (Slim) Laden / Electric Vehicles (EV). Daarbinnen zijn verschillende delivery ketens gedefinieerd om een zo goed en gewaardeerd product voor onze klanten te leveren. De Business Analist is de brug tussen business en IT. Door processen en data te analyseren, vertaalt hij/zij complexe vraagstukken naar heldere requirements en oplossingen die schaalbaarheid en efficiëntie ondersteunen. Met scherpe analyses en impactassessments helpt de Business Analist investeringen en innovaties te laten aansluiten op strategische doelen en draagt zo bij aan een professionele organisatie en optimale klantbeleving. Jouw rol De Business Analist (BA) is verantwoordelijk voor het verzamelen, analyseren en vertalen van business requirements naar duidelijke, uitvoerbare backlog-items. Het doel van de functie is om op basis van data, procesanalyses en klantinzichten verbeteringen en oplossingen te definiëren die bijdragen aan klantwaarde, operationele efficiëntie en strategische doelen. De BA zorgt voor transparantie in afhankelijkheden, risico’s en voortgang, zodat multidisciplinaire teams effectief kunnen leveren. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Business- en technologische behoeften, verzamelt, analyseert en vertaalt naar epics, user stories en acceptatiecriteria; Proces en technologie analyses uitvoert en verbetervoorstellen doet; Aannames valideert met data en klantinzichten requirements vastlegt en op basis hiervan een prioriteitstelling maakt op basis van business waarde; Vanuit één integraal overzicht rapportages ontwikkelt ter ondersteuning van Product en Business Owners afhankelijkheden en risico’s signaleert en mitigerende maatregelen voorstelt; Datakwaliteit en integriteit waarborgt van analyses afstemming faciliteert tussen Product-, Business Owners en andere stakeholders; Contacten onderhoudt met interne teams (IT, Marketing, Operations, Finance) en externe partijen indien relevant. Ons aanbod Bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.644,88,- en €5.849,10 (o.b.v. 38 uur) en een eindejaarsuitkering van 5,58%; Korting op verschillende ANWB-producten en -diensten; Volop trainings-, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden bij de ANWB Academie; Goede voorzieningen om thuis te werken en een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 per dag (onbelast) – de ANWB is voorstander van hybride werken; 25 verlofdagen en 13 ADV-dagen per jaar op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Ook kun je sparen voor extra verlof; Internetvergoeding van €35,- per maand; Persoonlijk inzetbaarheidsbudget tot €700 bruto per jaar; ANWB-lidmaatschap met Wegenwacht Nederland Standaard of de Wegenwacht Fiets Service; En uiteraard een geweldig team om samen onze klanten zo goed mogelijk te bedienen. Ons team Je komt terecht in een ambitieuze organisatie in opbouw, waarin multidisciplinaire teams vanuit strategie, productontwikkeling, techniek, marketing, finance en operatie intensief samenwerken. Samen bouwen we aan een fit-for-purpose energiebedrijf dat zowel leden als de energiemarkt positief verrast. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het chapter Product Delivery binnen de afdeling Digital. Hier werken (Senior) Product Owners en (Senior) Business Analisten samen aan digitale innovatie en productontwikkeling, het versterken van klantbeleving en de versnelling die nodig is om de energietransitie waar te maken. Het chapter Product Delivery vertaalt de klant- en businessbehoeften naar een duidelijke roadmap om releases en veranderingen voorspelbaar en met maximale waarde te realiseren. Binnen jouw multidisciplinaire team(s) werk je samen met specialisten uit verschillende vakgebieden, zoals architecten, service designers, developers, chapter (tech) leads, compliance, business developers en operations. Als achtergrond neem jij mee HBO/WO-werk- en denkniveau (in de richting van organisatiekunde, technische bedrijfskunde of economie); Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als Business Analist of vergelijkbaar in de energie- en/of mobiliteitssector; Ervaring met agile werkwijzen (zoals Scrum en Kanban) en werken met multidisciplinaire teams; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en stakeholder management: Ervaring met user stories, procesmodellen en requirements management en -documentatie; Sterk analytisch vermogen en ervaring met datagedreven werken opm het raakvlak van business en IT; Vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen, overzicht te houden en ‘nee’ te zeggen; Bekwaam in het vertalen van data naar inzichten en beslissingen; Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal; Ervaring met schaalvergroting in een scale-up omgeving is een pré.
